import numpy as np
import quimb.tensor as qtn

spec = dict(sites=9, bond_dimension=3, physical_dimension=2, maximum_degree=3, seed=123)
psi = qtn.TN_rand_tree(n=spec["sites"], D=spec["bond_dimension"],
                       phys_dim=spec["physical_dimension"],
                       max_degree=spec["maximum_degree"], seed=spec["seed"])
psi.equalize_norms_(1.0)
Z1 = float(psi.norm() ** 2)
gauges = {}
psi.gauge_all_simple_(max_iterations=800, tol=1e-12, gauges=gauges)

# For each bond b of each site i: build environment matrix
#   E_i[k,k'] = sum_{rest} t̂[i] * conj(t̂'[i])
# where t̂ has FULL gauge g inserted on every OTHER incident bond leg.
tid2site = psi._get_tid_to_site_map()

for tid in sorted(psi.tensor_map, key=lambda x: tid2site[x]):
    t = psi.tensor_map[tid]
    site = tid2site[tid]
    bonds = [ix for ix in t.inds if ix in psi._inner_inds]
    for ix in bonds:
        others = [x for x in bonds if x != ix]
        tg = t.copy()
        for ox in others:
            tg.multiply_index_diagonal_(ox, gauges[ox])
        bra = tg.H.reindex({ix: ix + "'"})
        E = (bra @ tg).data  # (ix', ix)
        diag = np.real(np.diag(E))
        off = np.abs(E - np.diag(np.diag(E))).max()
        g = gauges[ix]
        # candidate relations
        c1 = diag * g**2
        c2 = diag / g**2
        c3 = diag * g
        c4 = diag / g

            f"site {site} ix={ix}: offmax={off:.2e} "
            f"E*g^2 spread=[{c1.min():.3e},{c1.max():.3e}] "

d, db = 3, 3

B = qtn.Tensor(rng.normal(size=(db, d, 2)), inds=("b", ib, "pb"), tags={"B"})

g_outer_b = np.abs(rng.normal(size=d))
g_b = np.abs(rng.normal(size=db))
gauges = {ia: g_outer_a.copy(), ib: g_outer_b.copy(), "b": g_b.copy()}

tn = qtn.TensorNetwork([A, B])
val0 = tn.contract(all)
with tn.gauge_simple_temp(gauges):
    val0g = tn.contract(all)

tensor_gauge_simple_bond(A, B, gauges, renorm=True, info={"exponent": 0.0})

# gauge-representation invariance after update?
val1 = tn.contract(all)
newgauges = {k: (v[()] if False else v) for k, v in gauges.items()}
tn2 = tn.copy()
tn2.gauge_simple_insert(gauges)
val1g = tn2.contract(all)

print("after update val (no gauges):", val1, " with new gauges:", val1g)

# isometry check: A'=(A with FULL outer g on ia) x g_b(new) on bond should be
# left-isometry: sum_{ai,ph} |.|^2 = c*I_b  ?
gn = gauges["b"]
for t, oix, oside in ((A, ia, "left"), (B, ib, "right")):
    W = t.copy()
    W.multiply_index_diagonal_(oix, gauges[oix])
    if oside == "left":
        W.multiply_index_diagonal_("b", gn)
    X = W.data
    X = X.reshape(-1, db) if oside == "left" else X.reshape(db, -1)
    G = X.conj().T @ X if oside == "left" else X @ X.conj().T
    print(oside, "gram diag:", np.diag(G), " off:", np.abs(G - np.diag(np.diag(G))).max())

# also check directly with tensor_compress_bond on fresh pair
A2 = qtn.Tensor(rng.normal(size=(d, db, 2)), inds=(ia, "b", ph), tags={"A"})
B2 = qtn.Tensor(rng.normal(size=(db, d, 2)), inds=("b", ib, "pb"), tags={"B"})
A2.multiply_index_diagonal_(ia, g_outer_a)
B2.multiply_index_diagonal_(ib, g_outer_b)
A2.multiply_index_diagonal_("b", g_b)
info = {}
tensor_compress_bond(A2, B2, absorb=None, info=info, cutoff=0.0,

s = info["singular_values"]

X = B2.data.reshape(db, -1)
print("compress: B isometry gram:", np.diag(X @ X.conj().T))
print("singular values:", s)

import numpy as np
import quimb.tensor as qtn
from quimb.tensor.tensor_core import tensor_compress_bond

rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
d, db = 3, 3
ia, ib = "AI", "BI"
A = qtn.Tensor(rng.normal(size=(d, db, 2)), inds=(ia, "b", "ph"), tags={"A"})
B = qtn.Tensor(rng.normal(size=(db, d, 2)), inds=("b", ib, "pb"), tags={"B"})
g_outer_a = np.abs(rng.normal(size=d))
g_outer_b = np.abs(rng.normal(size=d))
g_b = np.abs(rng.normal(size=db))
A.multiply_index_diagonal_(ia, g_outer_a)
B.multiply_index_diagonal_(ib, g_outer_b)
A.multiply_index_diagonal_("b", g_b)

lix, bond_ind, rix = (ia, "ph"), "b", (ib, "pb")

# manually replicate reduced=True, absorb=None
ta_Q, ta_R = A.split(left_inds=lix, right_inds=bond_ind, bond_ind="t1", absorb="right", get="tensors", cutoff=0.0)
tb_R, tb_Q = B.split(left_inds=bond_ind, right_inds=rix, bond_ind="t2", absorb="left", get="tensors", cutoff=0.0)

def gram_isom(t, left_inds, rind):
    nleft = np.prod([t.ind_size(i) for i in left_inds])
    X = t.transpose(*left_inds, rind).data.reshape(int(nleft), -1)
    return np.abs(X.conj().T @ X - np.eye(t.ind_size(rind))).max()

print("ta_Q isom err:", gram_isom(ta_Q, [ia, "ph"], "t1"))
print("tb_Q isom err (right):", end=" ")
X = tb_Q.transpose("t2", ib, "pb").data
nr = np.prod([tb_Q.ind_size(i) for i in (ib, "pb")])
print(np.abs(X @ X.conj().T - np.eye(tb_Q.ind_size("t2"))).max())

tc = ta_R @ tb_R
tc_left, s, tc_right = tc.split(left_inds=["t1"], right_inds=["t2"], bond_ind=bond_ind, absorb=None, get="tensors")
print("tc_left isom:", np.abs(tc_left.data.conj().T @ tc_left.data - np.eye(db)).max())
print("tc_right isom:", np.abs(tc_right.data @ tc_right.data.conj().T - np.eye(db)).max())
print("s:", s.data)

ta_c = ta_Q.contract(tc_left, output_inds=A.inds)
tb_c = tc_right.contract(tb_Q, output_inds=B.inds)
X = ta_c.transpose(ia, "ph", bond_ind).data.reshape(-1, db)
print("ta_compressed gram:", np.diag(X.conj().T @ X))

# now compare with the real call
A2 = qtn.Tensor(A.data.copy(), inds=A.inds, tags=A.tags)
B2 = qtn.Tensor(B.data.copy(), inds=B.inds, tags=B.tags)
info = {}
tensor_compress_bond(A2, B2, absorb=None, info=info, cutoff=0.0, inds=((ia, "ph"), "b", (ib, "pb")))
X = A2.transpose(ia, "ph", "b").data.reshape(-1, db)
print("real call ta gram:", np.diag(X.conj().T @ X))
print("real call s:", info["singular_values"])
val = (A2 | B2)
ren = {i: i + "x" for i in ("b",)}

import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/task/source")

import numpy as np
import quimb.tensor as qtn

spec = dict(sites=9, bond_dimension=3, physical_dimension=2, maximum_degree=3, seed=123)
psi = qtn.TN_rand_tree(n=spec["sites"], D=spec["bond_dimension"],
                       phys_dim=spec["physical_dimension"],
                       max_degree=spec["maximum_degree"], seed=spec["seed"])
psi.equalize_norms_(1.0)
Z1 = float(psi.norm() ** 2)
gauges = {}
psi.gauge_all_simple_(max_iterations=800, tol=1e-12, gauges=gauges)

tid2site = psi._get_tid_to_site_map()
print("per (site,bond) E_s diagonal entries (E_s frame = full g on OTHER legs):")
for tid in sorted(psi.tensor_map, key=lambda x: tid2site[x]):
    t = psi.tensor_map[tid]
    site = tid2site[tid]
    bonds = [ix for ix in t.inds if ix in psi._inner_inds]
    for ix in bonds:
        others = [x for x in bonds if x != ix]
        tg = t.copy()
        for ox in others:
            tg.multiply_index_diagonal_(ox, gauges[ox])
        bra = tg.H.reindex({ix: ix + "'"})
        E = (bra @ tg).data
        diag = np.real(np.diag(E))
        # is it scalar*I?
        print(f"  site {site} bond {ix[-5:]}: diag={np.array2string(diag, precision=6)} "
              f"scalarI={np.abs(diag - diag[0]).max():.2e}")

# check bond consistency: for a site, q computed from each bond frame should match
print("\nGauge vector norms per bond:")
for ix, g in gauges.items():
    print(f"  bond {ix[-5:]}: ||g||={np.linalg.norm(g):.6e} entries={np.array2string(g, precision=4)}")

import sys

import itertools
import numpy as np
import quimb.tensor as qtn

spec = dict(sites=9, bond_dimension=3, physical_dimension=2, maximum_degree=3, seed=123)
psi = qtn.TN_rand_tree(n=spec["sites"], D=spec["bond_dimension"],
                       phys_dim=spec["physical_dimension"],
                       max_degree=spec["maximum_degree"], seed=spec["seed"])
psi.equalize_norms_(1.0)
Z_true = float(psi.norm() ** 2)
gauges = {}
psi.gauge_all_simple_(max_iterations=800, tol=1e-12, gauges=gauges)
g2 = {k: (v / np.linalg.norm(v)).copy() for k, v in gauges.items()}


def region_Z(region, cut_power, inner_power=1.0):
    """Contraction of region with gauges:
    - internal bonds: sqrt per side (power=inner_power split) ... we emulate:
    - cut bonds: insert g**cut_power fully into the single tensor (ket),
      bra gets same via H.
    """
    tags = tuple(map(psi.site_tag, region))
    kr = psi.select(tags, which="any", virtual=False)
    # insert into ket: outer (cut) with power cut_power, inner via total inner_power
    kg = {ix: g ** cut_power for ix, g in g2.items()}
    kr.gauge_simple_insert(kg)  # outer: full^cut; inner: sqrt^cut each side
    return float((kr.H & kr).contract(all))


# Convention A: current code (cut full g)
ZA = np.prod([region_Z((s,), 1.0) for s in psi.sites])
# Convention B: cut sqrt
ZB = np.prod([region_Z((s,), 0.5) for s in psi.sites])
print("true Z      :", Z_true)
print("A prod singles cut=1.0:", ZA, " ratio:", Z_true / ZA)
print("B prod singles cut=0.5:", ZB, " ratio:", Z_true / ZB)

# singles-only Möbius already handles trees: product over singles with
# the correct convention should equal Z exactly.

# also check pair consistency: with cut_power=0.5, regions singles + each
# bond as pair with count -1 should ALSO give Z (Bethe):
pairs = []
for ix in psi.inner_inds():
    tids = psi.ind_map[ix]
    sites = tuple(sorted(tid2site for tid2site in (psi._get_tid_to_site_map()[t] for t in tids)))
    pairs.append(sites)
ZB_bethe = ZB * np.prod([region_Z(p, 0.5) ** -1 for p in pairs])
print("B Bethe (singles * pairs^-1):", ZB_bethe, "ratio:", Z_true / ZB_bethe)

                       phys_dim=spec["physical_dimension"],
                       max_degree=spec["maximum_degree"], seed=spec["seed"])
psi.equalize_norms_(1.0)
Z_true = float(psi.norm() ** 2)
gauges = {}
psi.gauge_all_simple_(max_iterations=800, tol=1e-12, gauges=gauges)
g2 = {k: (v / np.linalg.norm(v)).copy() for k, v in gauges.items()}

tid2site = psi._get_tid_to_site_map()

prod_sqrt = 1.0
prod_full = 1.0
for site in sorted(psi.sites):
    t = psi[psi.site_tag(site)]
    bonds = [ix for ix in t.inds if ix in psi._inner_inds]
    for mode, acc in (("sqrt", "prod_sqrt"), ("full", "prod_full")):
        tg = t.copy()
        for ix in bonds:
            g = g2[ix]
            vec = np.sqrt(g) if mode == "sqrt" else g
            tg.multiply_index_diagonal_(ix, vec)
        q = float((tg.H.reindex({ix: ix + "'" for ix in bonds}) @ tg.copy())) if False else \
            np.sum(np.abs(tg.data) ** 2)
        if mode == "sqrt":
            prod_sqrt *= q
        else:
            prod_full *= q

print("uniform-sqrt singles product:", prod_sqrt, " ratio to true:", Z_true / prod_sqrt)
print("full singles product        :", prod_full, " ratio to true:", Z_true / prod_full)

# uniform-sqrt on the WHOLE tree should equal Z with sqrt(sqrt)=1/4 per ket side?
# check full-network convention: ket tensor with sqrt per leg inserted, bra likewise:
kg = psi.copy()
g4 = {ix: np.sqrt(v) for ix, v in g2.items()}
kg.gauge_simple_insert(g4)  # inner: (sqrt g)^1/2 = g^1/4 per side; outer(phys) none
Zchk = float((kg.H & kg).contract(all))
print("whole TN with sqrt-per-side insertion:", Zchk, " ratio:", Z_true / Zchk)

bonds = sorted((tuple(sorted(tid2site[t] for t in psi.ind_map[ix])), ix)

adj = {s: [] for s in sites}
for (a, b), ix in bonds:

    out = tn.contract_inds(

    gauges_ = g2 if gauges_ is None else gauges_
    tags = tuple(map(psi.site_tag, region))
    kr = psi.select(tags, which="any", virtual=False)
    kr.gauge_simple_insert(gauges_)

import sys

import numpy as np
import quimb.tensor as qtn


def analyze(psi):
    Z_true = float(psi.norm() ** 2)
    gauges = {}
    psi.gauge_all_simple_(max_iterations=800, tol=1e-13, gauges=gauges)
    g = {k: (v / np.linalg.norm(v)).copy() for k, v in gauges.items()}

    tid2site = psi._get_tid_to_site_map()

    def z_site(site, p):
        t = psi[psi.site_tag(site)]
        tg = t.copy()
        for ix in t.inds:
            if ix in psi._inner_inds:
                tg.multiply_index_diagonal_(ix, g[ix] ** p)
        return float(np.sum(np.abs(tg.data) ** 2))

    # formula candidates: Z = prod z_i(p) * prod_b o_b(p)^{-1}
    for p in (0.5, 1.0, 2.0):
        prod = 1.0
        for s in psi.sites:
            prod *= z_site(s, p)
        for ix in psi.inner_inds():
            o = np.sum(g[ix] ** (2 * p))
            prod /= o
        print(f"  p={p}: BP-style = {prod:.6e}  Z = {Z_true:.6e}  ratio = {Z_true/prod:.6e}")

    # also without overlaps (= singleton products)
    for p in (1.0, 2.0):
        prod = np.prod([z_site(s, p) for s in psi.sites])
        print(f"  singles-only p={p}: ratio = {Z_true/prod:.6e}")


print("workload tree:")
psi = qtn.TN_rand_tree(n=9, D=3, phys_dim=2, max_degree=3, seed=123)
psi.equalize_norms_(1.0)
